test_title: PYST 59: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I still / do not understand / why he did not / reply my email.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"reply"** is an **intransitive verb**, which means it does not take a direct object without a preposition.
 
• The correct usage is: **"reply to my email"**, not "reply my email".
 
• So, the segment **"reply my email"** contains the grammatical error due to the missing preposition "to".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I still do not understand why he did not **reply to** my email."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "why he did not"** – grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2: "I still"** – grammatically correct and appropriate in context.
 
• **Option 4: "do not understand"** – correct verb usage in present tense.
